name: Ferienwohnung Margreiter
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Margreiter is located on the edge of Kufstein, just a few minutes from the city center. The apartment is practically furnished and offers a view of the surrounding mountains. Guests will find a quiet accommodation with good access to the city's infrastructure. The amenities include a kitchenette, a separate bedroom, and a bathroom. Parking is available.
